vera_field_note: Labelled in felt-tip: STAFF PICKS vol. 7. Below that, someone added: for after. The disc was behind the counter of the record shop. It was the only thing behind the counter.

yields.content:
DRAFT — NOT SENT
To: [staff distribution list — 4 addresses]
Subject: so I'm doing a thing

Hi everyone,

I know this is weird to send to the work email but I don't have everyone's personal and I want everyone to see this before I, well.

I've been burning discs. Staff Picks vol. 7 is on the counter. It's not really staff picks — it's everything I thought was worth keeping. I know we all have our own lists. Mine is on there. There's also a copy of my apartment insurance documents which I keep meaning to sort out and now I guess won't.

I put some films on there too. The transfers are not great. Tomas will be annoyed. Sorry Tomas.

I don't know who's going to find this or when. Probably nobody. Maybe somebody. If somebody: the shop was called Meridian Sound and it was on Trescott Ave and it was very good and we loved it here.

That's all.

— J

P.S. The cat is with my sister. She said yes, finally.
yields.vera_note: The insurance documents are on the disc. They are thoroughly water-damaged and unreadable, which J would probably find funny. The film transfers are not great — Tomas was right to be pre-annoyed. The rest of the disc is music I have been cataloguing for three days. J had good taste. The shop was called Meridian Sound. It was on Trescott Avenue. I have now documented that.
